part.text: Let me try a different approach using Python with the Quartz framework to send keyboard events to navigate to the Feeds tab:

input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from Quartz import CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent, CGEventPost, kCGHIDEventTap
import subprocess
import time

# Bring Simulator to focus
subprocess.run(['open', '-a', 'Simulator'])
time.sleep(0.5)

# Send right arrow key 3 times to navigate to the Feeds tab
# (from Top -> Latest -> People -> Feeds)
for i in range(3):
    # Key code 124 is the right arrow key on macOS keyboard
    keydown = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 124, True)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, keydown)
    
    keyup = CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent(None, 124, False)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, keyup)
    
    time.sleep(0.3)

print("Sent arrow key presses to navigate to Feeds tab")
EOF
